Agent Name: DataVerification_Expert
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: It misinterpreted sparse search evidence to conclude that Iram N. Khan had no pre-2015 publications, incorrectly selecting the wrong author as the one with prior work. This misclassification redirected the pipeline to focus on Pietro Murano, making subsequent steps pursue the wrong branch and rendering recovery unlikely without revisiting the author decision. Later errors (including the fabricated earliest title) were downstream consequences of this initial misstep.
